## G — Definition of done matrix, Sharing the road

Definition of done dispositions for the merged sharing the road dossier. Domains covered: the Sharing the road domain carries every rule from the selected pages in part C. Passing standard: part A records it as unknown with no asserted value. High-yield ranked lists: present for the domain in parts C and C2. Misconceptions: covered as confusable pairs with stated differences in part C2. Mnemonics: not applicable, since the handbook pages hold no field mnemonics for sharing the road. Glossary: key terms are defined inside the part C fact blocks. Dynamic isolation: part D records how time-variable figures were handled. Competitive teardown and market pack: recorded as scoped dispositions in parts E2 and E. Accuracy and verify list: attested in parts D and F.
